description: Defines an abstract base class for interruption strategies in a bot system, allowing different strategies to determine when a user can interrupt bot speech. It includes methods for appending audio and text data, checking whether to interrupt, and resetting state.

classes.name: BaseInterruptionStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing the interface and common behavior for various interruption strategies. It uses Python's ABC module to enforce implementation of key methods for determining if interruption should occur.

methods.name: append_audio(self, audio: bytes, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Default method to append audio data for analysis; does nothing unless overridden.

methods.name: append_text(self, text: str)
methods.description: Default method to append text data for analysis; does nothing unless overridden.

methods.name: bool should_interrupt(self)
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented to decide if interruption should occur based on accumulated data.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to reset the internal state of the strategy.

ctags.name: append_audio
ctags.pattern: /^    async def append_audio(self, audio: bytes, sample_rate: int):$/
